title: 汐見ブリーズ
artist: 汐見ベイ・フュージョン
caption: 1980s Japanese jazz fusion instrumental with a city pop feel. Bright lead electric guitar melody with chorus effect, funky slap bass, crisp tight drums, glassy digital electric piano, synth brass hits, a lyrical soprano saxophone trading the melody with the guitar. Breezy, sunny, optimistic, a seaside highway. Polished analog studio production. Instrumental, no vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
